title: What Do You Mean by That?
blurb: Somebody has said something that could be entirely innocent or could be a direct shot, and this clip refuses to let the ambiguity stand. Demanding clarification is a genuinely aggressive move, since it forces the other person either to escalate or to back down in public. All the tension lives right there. Play it after backhanded compliments, after 'no offence but', and after any message ending in a full stop when it did not need one. Say it again. Explain the second half.
